Subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder & MAP next steps (Redwood + AcmeWidgets)

Hi Lena + Tom —

Thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary decision criteria: low-latency inference for customer-facing features, strong security controls (SOC2, KMS), predictable unit costs.
- Stakeholders identified:
  * Economic buyer: Lena Ortiz (VP Product)
  * Security lead: Tom Baker (SRE/Security)
  * Procurement: procurement@acmewidgets.com (we discussed PO process)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm procurement email and target PO timeline? (Lena)
2) Tom — can we schedule a short technical security call next week to review SOC2 artifacts and KMS options?
3) I will prepare a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone dates and acceptance criteria and share a one-page tracker + spreadsheet.
4) We will attach our SOC2 package and a proposed SOW template for legal review.

Proposed timeline (tentative)
- Technical call (security deep-dive): by 2026-06-05
- Legal review / T&Cs: target sign-off by 2026-06-15
- Procurement PO: target 2026-06-25
- Contract signature & kickoff: by 2026-06-30

If these dates look feasible, I’ll circulate the MAP and a DocuSign-ready SOW. Please flag any blockers.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Neha — quick internal note: 

Thanks for the tidy recap. A couple of internal asks before we send the official MAP: 
- Pricing: I’m okay to offer a 15% promotional credit (one-time account credit) if we can secure signature by 2026-06-30. Vivek, please confirm if that remains within promo budget.
- Confirm licensing model (hosted API usage + dedicated if they exceed threshold). If they need predictable throughput, we should include Dedicated options in the MAP.
- I’ve attached our procurement template (I’ll drop in the shared drive) — ask them to provide standard PO terms or redlines.

I’ll defer to you on timelines and to loop Legal if they push for enterprise amendments.

Ben

- Timeline: target PO by 2026-06-25, final contract signature no later than 2026-06-30. Those dates are what Procurement has committed to if we can meet our internal legal timeline.

Neha / team —

Thanks for the MAP. A few technical clarifications from Security before we commit to the proposed acceptance criteria: 

1) Data residency: can Redwood guarantee inference-only traffic and logs remain in us-east-1? We need a region lock option and a statement for our legal team.
2) KMS / key management: do you support customer-managed keys (CMK) in an HSM or KMS we control? If so, what is the integration path?
3) SOC2: I see the SOC2 pack attached; I’ll review and may have a couple of control questions (esp. around access logging and key rotation cadence).

Availability for a technical deep-dive: 2026-06-05 10:00-11:00 PDT or 2026-06-06 14:00-16:00 PDT. Please confirm and include whoever owns KMS/infrastructure on Redwood’s side.

Tom Baker
SRE / Security Lead | AcmeWidgets
tom.baker@acmewidgets.com
